text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The aromatherapy I lit last night
was a lot stronger than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A smell might have gotten into my hair... Is that why
people have been glancing at me this whole time...?

text_block_list.name: Friend Umamusume
text_block_list.text: There's a strange scent in the air today. ...Is that a new aroma blend?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
The smell definitely soaked into my clothes...!
Afterward, Mejiro Dober trained away from the others, self-conscious about the aroma's scent, but unable to fully focus, it ended in terrible results.
